result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: a restaurant card is displaying an image-error placeholder instead of its intended image.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card contains a large gray image placeholder/broken-image icon where the restaurant photo should appear, making the listing look incomplete and unreliable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image URL and loading state are handled correctly. Show the actual image when available, and use a deliberate branded fallback image rather than a broken-image placeholder if loading fails.
